Messages.Author: Andres Hernandez
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Just one question, can you play action modifiers cards that give you
votes (i.e. bewitching oration) even when you need the vote to win the
referendum? (i.e. you have 1 prince, and there aren´t any other votes
in the table).

Thanks for answering,

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:


There are no restrictions on playing appropriate action modifiers
(outside of the normal limit of one copy of an action modifier card per
minion per action) during a referendum. Meaning that you can play
Bewitching Oration regardless of whether you are winning the vote or
not. The same applies to reaction cards such as Dread Gaze. Voter
Captivation and Elder Kindred Network are examples of cards that would
make it desirable have a vote pass or fail by an overwhelming majority.

I hope this helps.

Regards,
Noal McDonald
VEKN Prince of Metro Detroit
